title: Verdant WSG evidence snapshot

wsg_edition.label: W3C Web Sustainability Guidelines TR snapshot reviewed on 2026-09-22

scope: Selected implementation evidence for the homepage and shared static assets in this repository. This record is not a live deployment audit and does not claim full WSG conformance.

entries.scope: Generated homepage HTML, shared stylesheet, and deferred scripts in repository build output.
entries.summary: The homepage build outputs one shared stylesheet and one deferred service-worker registration script. The component gallery adds a second deferred script for the theme toggle, so script counts vary by page.

entries.scope: Generated page structure and metadata for the homepage and component gallery.
entries.summary: Generated pages include landmarks, a skip link, a single h1 per page, a canonical URL, and JSON-LD website metadata.

entries.scope: Defaults shown in the generated pages and PandaCSS output.
entries.summary: Color-scheme, reduced-motion, and reduced-data behaviors are implemented for selected components and decorative assets. This snapshot documents those defaults only, not every WSG requirement.

entries.scope: Versioned static assets plus repository-managed Netlify headers and crawl files.
entries.summary: The repo includes CSP, HSTS, Permissions-Policy, nosniff, cache rules, robots.txt, and a sitemap. Deployed responses still depend on the hosting platform applying those files as configured.

entries.scope: Generated form, focus, theme, and motion examples in the component gallery.
entries.summary: The component gallery demonstrates labelled fields with autocomplete and inputmode, a visible focus style, no autoplay media, and system-font defaults.

entries.scope: Live deployment behavior outside the repository build output.
entries.summary: Green hosting provenance, CDN compression behavior, and final live-response headers need external verification. The repo can prepare assets and configuration, but it cannot prove deployed infrastructure outcomes on its own.
